SELECT "s".school AS "School Name", "s".county AS "County", "s".district AS "District", "s".city AS "City", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "K-12 Enrollment", "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS "K-12 FRPM Count", "f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "K-12 FRPM Percentage", "sat".numtsttakr AS "SAT Test Takers", "sat".avgscrread AS "Average Reading Score", "sat".avgscrmath AS "Average Math Score", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "Average Writing Score", "sat".numge1500 AS "Test Takers Total Score At Least 1500" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".school, "s".gsserved, "s".charter, "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS "free_rate" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Alameda' AND "s".gsserved ~ '(^|[^0-9])12([^0-9]|$)' AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), "top_rate" AS (SELECT MAX(free_rate) AS "rate" FROM "eligible") SELECT "e".school AS "school_name", TO_CHAR("e".free_rate, 'FM0.0000') AS "free_meal_rate", CASE WHEN "e".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "e".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter_school", "e".gsserved AS "grades_served", CASE WHEN "sat".cds IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "sat_performance_level" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "top_rate" AS "t" ON "e".free_rate = "t".rate LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "e".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".postid WHERE "c".score = 0 AND "c".postid IN (SELECT postid FROM "comments" GROUP BY postid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".age)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_age" FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "c".userid = "u".id WHERE "c".text LIKE '%http://%' AND "u".age IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "organizer".userid FROM "badges" AS "organizer" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "organizer".userid WHERE "organizer".name = 'Organizer' AND "u".location = 'Germany' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "badges" AS "prior" WHERE "prior".userid = "organizer".userid AND "prior".date < "organizer".date) >= 5) AS "qualifying_users" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "user_count" FROM (SELECT "p".owneruserid, MIN("p".creaiondate) AS "first_post_date" FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".owneruserid) AS "first_posts" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "first_posts".owneruserid WHERE "first_posts".first_post_date >= '2010-01-01' AND "first_posts".first_post_date < '2011-01-01' AND "u".location = 'India' LIMIT 501

WITH "posts_2012" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".score, "p".lasteditoruserid FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2013-01-01'), "editor_users" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "u".id, "u".reputation FROM "posts_2012" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%') SELECT COALESCE(SUM("p".score) FILTER (WHERE "u".id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "germany_editor_posts_total_score", COALESCE(SUM("p".score) FILTER (WHERE "u".id IS NULL), 0) AS "other_posts_total_score", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "editor_users") AS "germany_based_editors_count", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reputation), 0) FROM "editor_users") AS "combined_reputation" FROM "posts_2012" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid AND "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' LIMIT 501
SELECT SUM(reputation) FROM "users" INNER JOIN "posts" ON "users".id = "posts".owneruserid WHERE "posts".score = 10 AND "posts".tags LIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) AS "combined_reputation" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".lasactivitydate >= '2014-08-27'::DATE AND "p".lasactivitydate < '2014-08-28'::DATE LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("linking".score), 0) AS "total_score" FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "linking" ON "linking".id = "pl".postid INNER JOIN "posts" AS "target" ON "target".id = "pl".relatedpostid WHERE "target".title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?' AND "linking".tags ILIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 501

WITH "user_badge_totals" AS (SELECT "u".id, "u".displayname, COUNT("b".id) AS "badge_total" FROM "users" AS "u" LEFT JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'Germany' GROUP BY "u".id, "u".displayname), "ranked_totals" AS (SELECT badge_total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS "total_rank" FROM "user_badge_totals") SELECT DISTINCT "ubt".displayname, "ubt".badge_total FROM "user_badge_totals" AS "ubt" INNER JOIN "ranked_totals" AS "rt" ON "rt".badge_total = "ubt".badge_total WHERE "rt".total_rank = 2 ORDER BY "ubt".displayname ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation FROM "users" WHERE (location ILIKE '%California%' OR location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])CA([^[:alnum:]]|$)') AND views = (SELECT MAX(views) FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%California%' OR location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])CA([^[:alnum:]]|$)') LIMIT 501
SELECT age FROM "users" WHERE location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom') AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".userid) FROM "badges" AS "b" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%India%' AND "b".name = 'Yearling' AND "b".date < '2014-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".displayname) FROM "badges" AS "b" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "b".name = 'Supporter' AND "u".age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 LIMIT 501

WITH "matching_posts" AS (SELECT id, title FROM "posts" WHERE title ILIKE '%principal component scores%'), "related_counts" AS (SELECT "mp".id, "mp".title, COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".id) AS "related_post_count" FROM "matching_posts" AS "mp" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "pl" ON "pl".postid = "mp".id OR "pl".relatedpostid = "mp".id GROUP BY "mp".id, "mp".title), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, title, related_post_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY related_post_count DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "related_counts") SELECT title, related_post_count FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT id FROM "users" WHERE displayname = 'Michael' ORDER BY creationdate DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE("p".owneruserid::TEXT, "p".ownerdisplayname)) AS "user_count" FROM "votes" AS "v" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "v".postid WHERE "v".bountyamount >= 30 AND "v".creationdate >= DATE '2010-01-01' AND "v".creationdate < DATE '2011-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2011-01-01') AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'India' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("user_metrics".upvotes_cast), 2) AS "average_upvotes_cast", ROUND(AVG("user_metrics".age), 2) AS "average_age" FROM (SELECT "u".id, "u".age, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "posts_created", COUNT("v".id) AS "upvotes_cast" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id LEFT JOIN "votes" AS "v" ON "v".userid = "u".id AND "v".votetypeid = 2 WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2013-01-01' GROUP BY "u".id, "u".age HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) > 10) AS "user_metrics" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(SUM(monthly_count)::NUMERIC / 12, 2) AS "average_monthly_posts" FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', "pl".creationdate) AS "month_start", COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) AS "monthly_count" FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-01-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', "pl".creationdate)) AS "monthly" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "u".reputation < 1000 OR "p".owneruserid IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".score > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE("u".displayname, "ph".userdisplayname) AS "editor_display_name", COUNT(*) AS "edit_comment_count" FROM "posthistory" AS "ph" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "ph".userid WHERE "ph".postid = 118 AND "ph".comment IS NOT NULL AND "ph".comment <> '' GROUP BY COALESCE("u".displayname, "ph".userdisplayname) ORDER BY edit_comment_count DESC, editor_display_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '2013-01-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid), "winners" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment) segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "totals" ORDER BY segment ASC, total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC), "by_segment" AS (SELECT MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS "sme_total", MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS "lam_total", MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS "kam_total" FROM "winners") SELECT ROUND((sme_total - lam_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "SME minus LAM", ROUND((lam_total - kam_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "LAM minus KAM", ROUND((kam_total - sme_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "KAM minus SME" FROM "by_segment" LIMIT 501

WITH "yearly" AS (SELECT "c".segment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("y".date, 'YYYYMM')) AS "year", SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("y".date, 'YYYYMM')) IN (2012, 2013) GROUP BY "c".segment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("y".date, 'YYYYMM'))), "increases" AS (SELECT segment, 100.0 * (MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE year = 2013) - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE year = 2012)) / MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE year = 2012) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "yearly" GROUP BY segment), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) AS "low_value", MAX(increase_percentage) AS "high_value" FROM "increases") SELECT "i".segment, ROUND("i".increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "increases" AS "i" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "i".increase_percentage = "e".low_value OR "i".increase_percentage = "e".high_value ORDER BY "i".increase_percentage ASC, "i".segment ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_customer" AS (SELECT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date = DATE '2012-08-25' AND price::NUMERIC = 634.8), "annual_totals" AS (SELECT "ym".customerid, SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT("ym".date, 4) = '2012' THEN "ym".consumption ELSE 0 END) AS "total_2012", SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT("ym".date, 4) = '2013' THEN "ym".consumption ELSE 0 END) AS "total_2013" FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" INNER JOIN "target_customer" AS "tc" ON "tc".customerid = "ym".customerid WHERE LEFT("ym".date, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY "ym".customerid) SELECT ROUND(((total_2013 - total_2012) / NULLIF(total_2012, 0))::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "annual_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2012" ON "y2012".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2013" ON "y2013".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y2012".date >= '2012-01' AND "y2012".date < '2013-01' AND "y2013".date >= '2013-01' AND "y2013".date < '2014-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "active_2012" AS (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE "date" >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '2013-01-01'), "consumption_2012" AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201301' GROUP BY customerid) SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "active_2012" AS "a" ON "a".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "consumption_2012" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".total_consumption < 30000 GROUP BY "c".segment ORDER BY "c".segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "y".customerid) AS "customers_who_consumed_fuel_in_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '2013-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01' AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("t"."date" + "t"."time"::TIME) - MIN("t"."date" + "t"."time"::TIME))) / 60)::BIGINT AS "elapsed_whole_minutes" FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gasstations" AS "g" ON "t".gasstationid = "g".gasstationid WHERE "g".country = 'CZE' AND "t".price > 1000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT customerid FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '2013-01' AND date < '2013-12' AND consumption > 0 GROUP BY customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT date) = 11) AS "active" ON "active".customerid = "c".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, ROUND(AVG("q".quarter_consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_quarter_consumption" FROM (SELECT "ym".customerid, SUM("ym".consumption) AS "quarter_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" WHERE "ym".date >= '2013-04-01' AND "ym".date < '2013-07-01' GROUP BY "ym".customerid) AS "q" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "q".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency ORDER BY "c".currency ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly_totals" AS (SELECT "date", SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201401' GROUP BY "date"), "yearly_peaks" AS (SELECT LEFT("date", 4) AS "year", MAX(total_consumption) AS "peak_total" FROM "monthly_totals" GROUP BY LEFT("date", 4)) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN peak_total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN peak_total END)) AS "difference" FROM "yearly_peaks" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(monthly_consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_monthly_fuel_consumption" FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING("date", 1, 7) AS "month", SUM(consumption) AS "monthly_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 15621 AND "date" >= '2013-01' AND "date" < '2014-01' AND consumption > 0 GROUP BY SUBSTRING("date", 1, 7)) AS "monthly_fuel" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(customer_avg) FROM (SELECT "ym".customerid, AVG("ym".consumption) AS "customer_avg" FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "ym".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "ym".date >= '2012-01' AND "ym".date < '2013-01' GROUP BY "ym".customerid) AS "czk") - (SELECT AVG(customer_avg) FROM (SELECT "ym".customerid, AVG("ym".consumption) AS "customer_avg" FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "ym".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "ym".date >= '2012-01' AND "ym".date < '2013-01' GROUP BY "ym".customerid) AS "eur")) AS "difference" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "c".customerid FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date >= '2013-01-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY "c".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customerid) FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "t".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "products" AS "p" ON "t".productid = "p".productid WHERE "c".segment = 'SME' AND "t".date >= DATE '2013-02-01' AND "t".date < DATE '2013-03-01' AND "p".description IN ('Petrol', 'Petrol unleaded', 'Diesel', 'Diesel +', 'Biodiesel', 'Bonus BP diesel', 'Diesel aditiv', 'EKO Diesel', 'High performance diesel fuel', 'Red diesel', 'RED Diesel', 'SETA Diesel') LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "m".league_id WHERE "l".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m".season = '2009/2010' AND "m".away_team_goal > "m".home_team_goal GROUP BY "t".team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(away_wins) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "away_wins" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "m2".league_id WHERE "l2".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m2".season = '2009/2010' AND "m2".away_team_goal > "m2".home_team_goal GROUP BY "m2".away_team_api_id) AS "win_counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

WITH "tallest" AS (SELECT "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name, "p".height FROM "player" AS "p" WHERE "p".height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM "player")), "shortest" AS (SELECT "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name, "p".height FROM "player" AS "p" WHERE "p".height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM "player")), "compared" AS (SELECT "t".player_name, AVG("pa".finishing) AS "avg_finishing" FROM "tallest" AS "t" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "t".player_api_id GROUP BY "t".player_api_id, "t".player_name UNION ALL SELECT "s".player_name, AVG("pa".finishing) AS "avg_finishing" FROM "shortest" AS "s" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "s".player_api_id GROUP BY "s".player_api_id, "s".player_name) SELECT player_name FROM "compared" ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC LIMIT 1

WITH "first_month" AS (SELECT MIN(DATE_TRUNC('month', date)) AS "month_start" FROM "account"), "opened_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_month" AS "f" WHERE "a".date >= "f".month_start AND "a".date < "f".month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'), "populations" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4 AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "opened_districts" AS "od" ON "od".district_id = "d".district_id) SELECT a2, inhabitants FROM "populations" WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM "populations") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND ("t".k_symbol = '' OR "t".k_symbol = ' ') LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "district" AS "d" ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC LIMIT 5), "account_counts" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, "td".district_name, COUNT("a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "td".district_id GROUP BY "td".district_id, "td".district_name), "loan_totals" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount) FILTER (WHERE "l".status IN ('C', 'D')), 0) AS "active_loan_amount" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "td".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "td".district_id) SELECT "ac".district_name, ROUND("lt".active_loan_amount::NUMERIC / "ac".account_count) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "account_counts" AS "ac" INNER JOIN "loan_totals" AS "lt" ON "lt".district_id = "ac".district_id WHERE ROUND("lt".active_loan_amount::NUMERIC / "ac".account_count) = (SELECT MAX(ROUND("lt2".active_loan_amount::NUMERIC / "ac2".account_count)) FROM "account_counts" AS "ac2" INNER JOIN "loan_totals" AS "lt2" ON "lt2".district_id = "ac2".district_id) LIMIT 501

WITH "region_totals" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day') >= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "d".a3) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "region_totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "region_totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "branch_district".district_id, "branch_district".a11 FROM "district" AS "branch_district" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "branch_district".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "branch_district".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_of_districts_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_districts" FROM "qualifying_districts" LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_clients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".client_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "any_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "any_disp".disp_id WHERE "any_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id)), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "eligible_clients") SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries" FROM "eligible_districts" AS "ed" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ed".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "account".account_id, COUNT("loan".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "client" ON "client".client_id = "disp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan" ON "loan".account_id = "account".account_id WHERE "disp".type = 'OWNER' AND "client".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' GROUP BY "account".account_id) AS "account_loan_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> '' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".account_id IN (SELECT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", "d2".district_id AS "home_district_id", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date, "d2".district_id), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "outside_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".outside_counterparties, 0) AS "outside_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a11 AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a11 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "borrowing" AS "b" INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "b".home_district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "b".account_id ORDER BY "home".a11 DESC, "b".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "gender_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "cl".gender, "a".district_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".disp_id = "c".disp_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "dist" ON "dist".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold' AND "cl".gender IN ('F', 'M') AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000 AND "dist".a8 > 100000), "district_values" AS (SELECT "gd".gender, "dist".district_id, "dist".a8 AS "inhabitants", "dist".a11 AS "salary", "dist".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "gender_districts" AS "gd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "dist" ON "dist".district_id = "gd".district_id), "group_stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", AVG(salary) AS "avg_salary", AVG(urban_ratio) AS "avg_urban_ratio", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM "district_values" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "dv".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS "gender", "gs".district_count, "dv".district_id, "dv".inhabitants, ROUND("gs".avg_salary::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND("gs".avg_urban_ratio::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_inhabitant_ratio" FROM "district_values" AS "dv" INNER JOIN "group_stats" AS "gs" ON "gs".gender = "dv".gender WHERE "dv".inhabitants = "gs".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "dv".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "dv".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t"."k_symbol" = 'SIPO' THEN "t"."amount" ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t"."amount"), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t"."account_id" = "a"."account_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a"."district_id" = "d"."district_id" WHERE "d"."a2" ILIKE 'Pisek' AND "t"."type" = 'VYDAJ' AND "t"."k_symbol" <> ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".client_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "o" ON "o".client_id = "c".client_id AND "o".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".account_id = "o".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "cd".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "o".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "ed" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "e".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a8 AS "population", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a13 AS "unemployment_1996" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "e".district_id) SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", (ARRAY_AGG(district_name ORDER BY population DESC, district_name ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district" FROM "ed" GROUP BY region LIMIT 501

WITH "district_counts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a5::BIGINT AS "crimes_1996" FROM "district" AS "d"), "top_three" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, inhabitants, crimes_1996 FROM "district_counts" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, translate(lower(district_name), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 3), "all_average" AS (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996::NUMERIC) AS "avg_crimes" FROM "district_counts"), "top_average" AS (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996::NUMERIC) AS "avg_crimes" FROM "top_three") SELECT "t".district_name, "t".inhabitants, "t".crimes_1996, ROUND("ta".avg_crimes, 2) AS "three_district_average_crimes", ROUND("aa".avg_crimes, 2) AS "overall_average_crimes", ROUND("ta".avg_crimes - "aa".avg_crimes, 2) AS "difference" FROM "top_three" AS "t" CROSS JOIN "top_average" AS "ta" CROSS JOIN "all_average" AS "aa" ORDER BY "t".inhabitants DESC, translate(lower("t".district_name), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "d"."district_id", "d"."a2" AS "district_name", "d"."a4" AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."disp_id" = "ca"."disp_id" INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl"."client_id" = "dp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "cl"."district_id"), "ranked" AS (SELECT card_type, district_name, inhabitants, MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS "min_inhabitants" FROM "card_districts") SELECT card_type, district_name, inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "target_region")), "ending_balances" AS (SELECT "o".account_id, "o".district_id, "o".district_name, "t".balance FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "o".account_id AND "tr".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "tr".date DESC, "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "t" ON TRUE), "district_stats" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", AVG(balance)::NUMERIC AS "avg_balance" FROM "ending_balances" GROUP BY district_id, district_name), "region_stats" AS (SELECT AVG(balance)::NUMERIC AS "region_avg_balance" FROM "ending_balances"), "top_district" AS (SELECT district_name FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "ds".district_name, "ds".accounts_opened, ROUND("ds".avg_balance, 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND("rs".region_avg_balance, 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_of_1996_balance", "td".district_name AS "district_with_highest_average" FROM "district_stats" AS "ds" CROSS JOIN "region_stats" AS "rs" CROSS JOIN "top_district" AS "td" ORDER BY "ds".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "top_loans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "t".district_id), "leading_district" AS (SELECT district_id, inhabitants FROM "districts" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "ld".district_id, "ld".inhabitants AS "number of inhabitants", ROUND((SELECT AVG(average_salary)::NUMERIC FROM "districts"), 2) AS "average salary across districts" FROM "leading_district" AS "ld" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4 AS "population", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", ROUND(SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / NULLIF("d".a4::NUMERIC, 0), 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / NULLIF("d".a4::NUMERIC, 0) DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM("o".amount) FROM "account" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a2".account_id WHERE "a2".district_id = "d".district_id), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "account" AS "a3" WHERE "a3".district_id = "d".district_id), 0), 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "d".a4::NUMERIC >= 100000 GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4 ORDER BY rank ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened_date", "a".frequency, "ad".a2 AS "district_name", "ad".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "ad".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "ad".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "net_balance", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "client" AS "rc" INNER JOIN "district" AS "rcd" ON "rcd".district_id = "rc".district_id WHERE "rcd".a3 = "ad".a3) AS "clients_in_region", (SELECT "md".a2 FROM "district" AS "md" WHERE "md".a3 = "ad".a3 ORDER BY "md".a8 DESC, "md".district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "most_populous_district", (SELECT "md".a8 FROM "district" AS "md" WHERE "md".a3 = "ad".a3 ORDER BY "md".a8 DESC, "md".district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", (SELECT 1 + COUNT(*) FROM "district" AS "rd" WHERE "rd".a3 = "ad".a3 AND "rd".a8 > "ad".a8) AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".frequency, "ad".a2, "ad".a3, "ad".district_id, "c".district_id, "ad".a11, "l".status, "l".amount, "ad".a8 ORDER BY COUNT("t".trans_id) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT "al".district_id, TO_CHAR("al".date, 'YYYY') AS "account_year", SUM("al".amount_lent)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "amount_per_account" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "al".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "al".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "al".district_id, TO_CHAR("al".date, 'YYYY')), "yearly" AS (SELECT TO_CHAR("al".date, 'YYYY') AS "account_opening_year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "al".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "al".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("al".date, 'YYYY')) SELECT "y".account_opening_year, "y".accounts_opened, "y".total_amount_lent, ROUND(AVG("dy".amount_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "yearly" AS "y" INNER JOIN "district_year" AS "dy" ON "dy".account_year = "y".account_opening_year GROUP BY "y".account_opening_year, "y".accounts_opened, "y".total_amount_lent ORDER BY "y".account_opening_year ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_transactions" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, "t".date, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t".account_id, "t".date ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "trans" AS "t"), "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, "a".district_id, "rt".balance FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id LEFT JOIN "ranked_transactions" AS "rt" ON "rt".account_id = "l".account_id AND "rt".date = "l".date AND "rt".rn = 1 WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE') SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "e".amount AS "approved_amount", "e".date AS "approval_date", "e".balance AS "end_of_day_account_balance" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "e".district_id ORDER BY "e".amount DESC, "e".date ASC, "e".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH "loan_summary" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "card_clients" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "ca"."type" AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("ls".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan_summary" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "client_rows" AS (SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, loan_count, total_amount_borrowed, CASE WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card_clients") SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, loan_count, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, age_rank_within_gender FROM "client_rows" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count_accounts" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823) AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. WITH "editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year >= 1990 AND "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "c".name = 'Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours'), "driver_laps" AS (SELECT "e".raceid, "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, MIN("lt".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "editions" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".raceid = "e".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "lt".driverid GROUP BY "e".raceid, "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname) SELECT "e".date, "dl".forename, "dl".surname, CASE WHEN "dl".fastest_ms IS NOT NULL THEN ("dl".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN ("dl".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (("dl".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN "dl".fastest_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN "dl".fastest_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ("dl".fastest_ms % 1000)::TEXT END AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "editions" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "driver_laps" AS "dl" ON "dl".raceid = "e".raceid AND "dl".fastest_ms > 90000 ORDER BY "e".date ASC, "dl".surname ASC, "dl".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT "q2".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '' ORDER BY split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "q".q3, "d".forename, "d".surname, "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d".dob) > 1980 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> ''), "fastest" AS (SELECT MIN(q3) AS "q3" FROM "eligible") SELECT "e".forename || ' ' || "e".surname AS "full_name", "e".race_name, "e".race_year, "e".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "fastest" AS "f" ON "e".q3 = "f".q3 LIMIT 501

WITH "driver_race_fastest" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" GROUP BY raceid, driverid), "ranked" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY fastest_ms ASC) AS "lap_speed_rank" FROM "driver_race_fastest") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "count" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".lap_speed_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "season_points" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "season_row" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid), "career" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("sp".points) FILTER (WHERE "sp".season_row = 1), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "season_points" AS "sp" ON "sp".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".constructorid) FILTER (WHERE "r".rank = 1) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year AS "season_year", COUNT("p".stop) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19 AND "d".nationality = 'Australian') AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 > '2:00.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

WITH "winner_candidates" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".dob, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "selected_driver" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality FROM "winner_candidates" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "r".name, "r".date FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "selected_driver" AS "sd" ON "sd".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 1), "starts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_starts" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "selected_driver" AS "sd" ON "sd".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) SELECT "sd".forename || ' ' || "sd".surname AS "full_name", "sd".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_race_won", "fw".date AS "first_win_date", "starts".total_starts FROM "selected_driver" AS "sd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" CROSS JOIN "starts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "re" ON "re".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "re".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "q".position ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q2 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3_value) FROM (SELECT "q2".q3 AS "q3_value" FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') AS "q3_times") LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "ru".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "ru" ON "ru".raceid = "r".raceid AND "ru".position = 2 INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time = (SELECT MIN("r2".time) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r2".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009) ORDER BY "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "c".name = 'Circuit Gilles Villeneuve' AND "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 < '01:38.000' LIMIT 501

WITH "race_times" AS (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest", MAX(start_time) AS "latest" FROM "race_times") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".earliest) AS "earliest_circuit_refs", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "rt".start_time = "e".latest) AS "latest_circuit_refs", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("e".latest - "e".earliest))::BIGINT AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extremes" AS "e" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "r".statusid = "s".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".position IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_expense_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_expense_total" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "x".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "x".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b1".amount::NUMERIC / NULLIF("b2".amount, 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b1" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e1" ON "b1".link_to_event = "e1".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".category = 'Advertisement' INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "b1".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e1".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND "e2".event_name = 'October Meeting' LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending", SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget_amount" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "ratios" AS (SELECT event_name, total_spending / NULLIF(total_budget_amount, 0) AS "spending_ratio" FROM "event_totals") SELECT event_name FROM "ratios" WHERE spending_ratio = (SELECT MAX(spending_ratio) FROM "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT 17 AS "womens_soccer_attendees", ROUND(AVG(attendees)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "fall_2019_average_attendees", CASE WHEN 17 > ROUND(AVG(attendees)::NUMERIC, 1) THEN 'more' WHEN 17 < ROUND(AVG(attendees)::NUMERIC, 1) THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "c" LIMIT 501

WITH "college_departments" AS (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "offered" AS (SELECT department, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT major_id) AS "major_count" FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' GROUP BY department), "members_by_department" AS (SELECT "m".department, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "m".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE "mem".member_id IS NOT NULL) AS "majors_held", COUNT("mem".member_id) AS "total_members" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id WHERE "m".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' GROUP BY "m".department) SELECT "d".department, "o".majors_offered, COALESCE("mbd".majors_held, '') AS "majors_held", ROUND("mbd".total_members::NUMERIC / NULLIF("o".major_count, 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "college_departments" AS "d" INNER JOIN "offered" AS "o" USING (department) INNER JOIN "members_by_department" AS "mbd" USING (department) ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COALESCE("a".member_count, 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM "event" WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND event_date < '2020-01-01') AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "ev".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "att".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "att" ON "att".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "ev".type) AS "a" ON "a".type = "e".type LEFT JOIN (SELECT "ev".type, SUM("bud".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "bud" ON "bud".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "ev".type) AS "b" ON "b".type = "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "mem".member_id, "mem".link_to_major FROM "member" AS "mem" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "mem".member_id WHERE "mem".position = 'Member') AS "enrolled_attendees" ON "enrolled_attendees".link_to_major = "m".major_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "enrolled_attendees".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "m".college = 'College of Engineering' GROUP BY "m".department ORDER BY "m".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".remaining)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "e".link_to_member, "e".link_to_budget FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".cost > 50) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "qualifying".link_to_budget GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "i".link_to_member = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "ma".major_name FROM "major" AS "ma" WHERE "ma".college = (SELECT "target_major".college FROM "major" AS "target_major" INNER JOIN "member" AS "tm" ON "tm".link_to_major = "target_major".major_id WHERE "tm".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tm".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "major" AS "same_name" INNER JOIN "member" AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "same_name".major_id WHERE "same_name".college = "ma".college AND "same_name".major_name = "ma".major_name)) AS "unstaffed_major_names" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS "average_attendees_per_advertising_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE LOWER("b".category) = 'advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS "count" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Alumni Glass' THEN 'Alumni Glass' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'Donuts' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Club shirts' THEN 'Club shirts' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Parking' THEN 'Parking' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Pizza' THEN 'Pizza' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' THEN 'Post Cards' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Posters' THEN 'Posters' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Travel Mug' THEN 'Travel Mug' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, Cookies' THEN 'Water' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'Water' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies' THEN 'Water' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, cookies, chips' THEN 'Water' END AS "item" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE remaining < 0) UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'muffins' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' THEN 'Posters' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, Cookies' THEN 'Cookies' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'Veggie tray' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies' THEN 'chips' WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, cookies, chips' THEN 'cookies' END AS "item" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE remaining < 0) UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN "x".expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'supplies' WHEN "x".expense_description IN ('Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips') THEN 'chips' END AS "item" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE remaining < 0)) AS "kinds" WHERE item IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "major"."college" = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'In College' ELSE 'Not in College' END AS "group", COUNT(*) AS "members" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member"."link_to_major" = "major"."major_id" GROUP BY CASE WHEN "major"."college" = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'In College' ELSE 'Not in College' END LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "e".event_id, "e".event_name FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'), "event_largest_line" AS (SELECT "ce".event_id, "ce".event_name, MAX("b".amount) AS "largest_line" FROM "chip_events" AS "ce" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ce".event_id GROUP BY "ce".event_id, "ce".event_name) SELECT event_name FROM "event_largest_line" WHERE largest_line = (SELECT MAX(largest_line) FROM "event_largest_line") LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "expense_date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".college AS "college", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "r" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "r".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "m".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "major_count" FROM "member" AS "r2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "r2".link_to_major = "m2".major_id GROUP BY "m2".college) AS "college_counts") ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ev".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "ex".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "bu" ON "bu".link_to_event = "ev".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "bu".budget_id WHERE "bu".amount > 40 GROUP BY "ev".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) <= COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "bx" ON "bx".budget_id = "x".link_to_budget WHERE "bx".link_to_event = "e".event_id) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "e"."type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e"."type") SELECT "type", member_count FROM "counts" WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501
