SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "blackwulf" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".publisher_id = "blackwulf".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_hero" ON "other_hero".eye_colour_id = "h".eye_colour_id AND "other_hero".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero".publisher_id <> "h".publisher_id WHERE "blackwulf".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "h".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "target_publisher" AS (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp" ON "s".publisher_id = "tp".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id GROUP BY "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "tp2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "s2".race_id = "r2".id GROUP BY "r2".race) AS "counts") ORDER BY "r".race ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "qualifying_heroes" ON "qualifying_heroes".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(BTRIM("s".full_name)) - LENGTH(REPLACE(BTRIM("s".full_name), ' ', '')) >= 1 GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "average_height_cm", AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' AND "sp".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "different_superpowers" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(COALESCE("power_counts".power_count, 0)) AS "max_superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "power_counts" ON "power_counts".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s"."alignment_id" = "a"."id" WHERE "a"."alignment" = 'Neutral' AND "s"."full_name" IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s"."full_name") <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name <> "s".superhero_name LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "hero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "hero".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "hero".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "brown_hero".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "brown_hero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_hair" ON "brown_hero".hair_colour_id = "brown_hair".id WHERE "brown_hair".colour = 'Brown') AND "hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "count_difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "flagged" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5)), "counts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M') AS "male_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F') AS "female_count" FROM "flagged") SELECT male_count::NUMERIC / NULLIF(female_count, 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 'FM999999990.00') || '%' AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest_rnp" AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "rnp"::INTEGER END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory"), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."id", "l"."date", "l"."T-BIL", "l"."rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest_rnp" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER = "s".max_rnp), "top_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_tbil" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL" AS "total bilirubin", "c"."date" AS "date", "p"."id" AS "patient ID", "p"."sex" AS "sex", "p"."birthday" AS "birthday" FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "c"."id" CROSS JOIN "top_bilirubin" AS "t" WHERE "c"."T-BIL" = "t".max_tbil LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "l".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT id, rnp_titer FROM "eligible" WHERE rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 GROUP BY id) AS "pl" ON "pl".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') GROUP BY id) AS "rn" ON "rn".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_date_count, 0)), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id AS "patient_id", "l".date AS "laboratory_test_date", "l".dna AS "anti_dna_antibody_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission DESC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "h" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "h".id WHERE ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND "r".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "highest_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".id IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400)) AS "with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400)) AS "never_with_normal_platelet" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_rnp" AS (SELECT "p".id, bool_or("l".rnp IS NOT NULL) AS "has_result", bool_or("l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')) AS "elevated" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' GROUP BY "p".id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE elevated) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_result), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient_rnp" WHERE has_result LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "q" ON "p".id = "q".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 32 GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT symptom FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "e".symptoms LIKE '%,%' THEN TRIM(split_part("e".symptoms, ',', 1)) ELSE "e".symptoms END AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(split_part("e".symptoms, ',', 2)) AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms LIKE '%,%') AS "episode_symptoms" GROUP BY symptom ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, symptom ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e"."diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."thrombosis" = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_examination_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_examination_date" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id AS "patient ID", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "group_max" AS (SELECT "p".admission, MAX("l"."T-CHO") AS "max_tcho" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".admission) SELECT "g".max_tcho AS "T-CHO", "g".admission AS "admission status", "p".id AS "patient ID" FROM "group_max" AS "g" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."T-CHO" = "g".max_tcho INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id AND "p".admission = "g".admission ORDER BY CASE "g".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p"."First Date") = 1991 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "scored" AS (SELECT id, rnp, CASE rnp WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '4' THEN 4 WHEN '15' THEN 15 WHEN '16' THEN 16 WHEN '64' THEN 64 WHEN '256' THEN 256 END AS "titer" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, rnp FROM "scored" WHERE titer = (SELECT MAX(titer) FROM "scored") LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ra IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_sc170" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "ls".id FROM "latest_sample" AS "ls" INNER JOIN "latest_sc170" AS "s" ON "s".id = "ls".id WHERE "ls".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l"."rnp"::INTEGER END) AS "highest_anti_rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."cre" < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "l".date, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "numeric_rnp" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$'), "maxima" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX("n".rnp_level) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "numeric_rnp" AS "n" ON "n".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex), "top_level" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "level" FROM "maxima") SELECT "m".id, "m".sex, "m".highest_rnp FROM "maxima" AS "m" INNER JOIN "top_level" AS "t" ON "m".highest_rnp = "t".level ORDER BY "m".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "l".id, "l".got, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN(date) AS "first_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "earliest" ON "l".id = "earliest".id AND "l".date = "earliest".first_date) AS "first_laboratory" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rn = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_patients" AS (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "l".id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) >= 16 AND BOOL_AND("l".gpt < 60)), "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible_patients" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id ORDER BY "r".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "r".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l"."date", "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna DESC, "l"."date" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "elevated" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256')), "patient_flags" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, ("v".id IS NOT NULL) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "elevated" AS "v" ON "v".id = "e".id) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_elevated_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_no_elevated_result" FROM "patient_flags" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND "l".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) AS "most_recent" WHERE "most_recent".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "most_recent".rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND "most_recent".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "high_ldh" ON "high_ldh".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" = '100' OR "U-PRO" = '300' OR "U-PRO" = '>=1000' OR "U-PRO" = '>=300' OR "U-PRO" = '+2(100)' OR "U-PRO" = '+3(300)' OR "U-PRO" = '+4(1000)' GROUP BY id) AS "significant_protein" ON "significant_protein".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "diagnosis" FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "admission" LIKE '+%' ORDER BY "birthday" ASC NULLS LAST, "id" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "number_of_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~ '(^|, )SjS(,|$)' AND "e".diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_normal" ON "l_normal".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_protein" ON "l_protein".id = "p".id WHERE "l_normal".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l_protein"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rbc_lab" ON "rbc_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_lab" ON "rnp_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("rbc_lab".rbc <= 3.5 OR "rbc_lab".rbc >= 6.0) AND "rnp_lab".rnp NOT IN ('0', 'negative') GROUP BY "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('0', '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecules_with_single_bond" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "bond" WHERE "bond_type" = '#') AS "triple_molecules" ON "triple_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "atom" WHERE "element" IN ('p', 'br')) AS "p_or_br_molecules" ON "p_or_br_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COUNT("b".bond_id) > 0 AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') THEN 'all_single' ELSE 'other' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_groups" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

WITH "positive_molecules" AS (SELECT molecule_id FROM "molecule" WHERE label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c"), "element_counts" AS (SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "positive_molecules" AS "pm" ON "pm".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bonded_atoms" AS "ba" ON "ba".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element), "all_positive_atoms" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "positive_molecules" AS "pm" ON "pm".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id), "maximum_count" AS (SELECT MAX(bonded_atom_count) AS "max_count" FROM "element_counts") SELECT "ec".element, ROUND(100.0 * "ec".bonded_atom_count / "apa".total_atoms, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_atoms" FROM "element_counts" AS "ec" CROSS JOIN "maximum_count" AS "mc" CROSS JOIN "all_positive_atoms" AS "apa" WHERE "ec".bonded_atom_count = "mc".max_count ORDER BY "ec".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM (SELECT "a"."molecule_id" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c"."atom_id" = "a"."atom_id" OR "c"."atom_id2" = "a"."atom_id" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b"."bond_id" = "c"."bond_id" GROUP BY "a"."molecule_id" HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "a"."element" = 'n' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN "a"."element" = 'n' AND "b"."bond_type" IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) AS "qualifying_molecules" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."atom_id2") AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" WHERE "a"."element" = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, SUM(CASE WHEN "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) ELSE 0 END) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_counts" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "carbon_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atoms" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "m".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "mc".molecule_id, "mc".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "mc".number_of_atoms, "mc".number_of_bonds, "mc".carbon_atoms, "mc".chlorine_atoms, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule_counts" AS "mc" INNER JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "mc".molecule_id WHERE "mc".carbon_atoms > 0) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, number_of_atoms, number_of_bonds, carbon_atoms, chlorine_atoms, carbon_touching_bonds, multiple_bonds FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "y" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "y".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "y".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "y".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "y".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END AND "h".molecule_id = "y".molecule_id WHERE "y".element = 'y' AND "h".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degrees" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".atom_id NOT IN (SELECT "c2".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id AND "b2".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
